open_points.subject: plan_run mapped empty-list elements
open_points.text: A mapped node's elements are the positions of the list delivered to its map_over port, counted from the JSON array its StoredValue holds — read with read_value_bytes, or the canonical_json of an AssembledList not yet written — or the files of its SpooledFilesRef;
open_points.other_text: a mapped node over an empty list is ready with over_empty_list and one element without map_index whose sources are the node's inputs as delivered — its map_over port's source is the source of the empty list itself, a RecordedSource or a MappedListSource, never a ListElementSource, which exists only for an element with a map_index;
open_points.question: Must an empty mapped list have no elements because elements are list positions, or must it have the specified synthetic element without map_index?

open_points.subject: plan_run guarded flow-input edges
open_points.text: flow inputs delivered along every edge from them — a flow input or output endpoint is the node_id empty string (A05 rule 2) —,
open_points.other_text: An edge whose source is a flow input (the node_id empty string) is decided from the start, since every flow input is delivered when the run starts: without a guard it is enabled, and a guarded one is decided as above from the flow input its guard_port names.
open_points.question: Are flow inputs delivered along every outgoing edge, or only along outgoing edges whose guards are enabled?
